amaze.en: Some of my friends, who are highly skilled, have amazing jobs in the USA.
amaze.zh: 我的一些朋友技能娴熟，在美国拥有令人惊艳的工作。

amaze.en: And speaking of amazing babies, what was the correct answer to your question, Beth?
amaze.zh: 说到可爱的宝宝，你问题的正确答案是什么，贝丝？

amaze.en: Although they look small and helpless, babies are born with some amazing abilities.
amaze.zh: 虽然婴儿看起来又小又无助，但他们天生具有一些惊人的能力。

amaze.en: It is. It’s an amazing statue. But you’re comparing two different things, right?
amaze.zh: 它是。这是一座令人惊叹的雕像。但你在比较两个不同的东西，对吧？

amaze.en: For instance, you might hear someone say a party was “lit “, meaning amazing or exciting.
amaze.zh: 比如，你可能会听到有人说某个派对很“lit”，意思是太棒了或令人兴奋。

ambitious.en: Venezuela, of course, is a socialist country, and they had really ambitious public spending programs.
ambitious.zh: 当然，委内瑞拉是一个社会主义国家，他们有雄心勃勃的公共开支项目。

ambitious.en: They didn’t seem very ambitious. Several government decisions were very unpopular as well.
ambitious.zh: 他们看起来并没有什么雄心壮志。几项政府决策也极不受欢迎。

ambitious.en: The European Union is one of the most ambitious political and economic projects in modern history.
ambitious.zh: 欧洲联盟是现代历史上最宏伟的政治和经济项目之一。

ambitious.en: I set myself a very ambitious goal, like passing an exam, and that is a good thing.
ambitious.zh: 我给自己设定了一个非常雄心勃勃的目标，比如通过一场考试，这本身是件好事。

ambitious.en: To aim high means to be ambitious and set high goals.
ambitious.zh: To aim high 意思是很有抱负并设定高目标。

amplify.en: In turn that's the content that algorithms will amplify, which ultimately means more advertising revenue.
amplify.zh: 反过来，这也是算法会放大的内容，这最终意味着更多的广告收入。

amplify.en: But even here, the pattern is the same. Dogs amplified human ability.
amplify.zh: 但即便在这里，模式也是一样的。狗放大了人类的能力。

amplify.en: The middle ear's main job is to amplify those sounds.
amplify.zh: 中耳的主要工作是放大这些声音。

amplify.en: Once in the middle ear, the eardrum amplifies the sounds before transmitting them to tiny hairs in the inner ear, which then sends electrical signals to the brain.
amplify.zh: 一旦进入中耳，耳膜就会放大声音，然后将其传输到内耳的微小毛细胞，最后毛细胞向大脑发送电信号。

ambiguous.en: And finally, the adjective ambiguous means having more than one possible meaning.
ambiguous.zh: 最后，形容词 ambiguous 意为具有一种以上的可能含义。

ambiguous.en: So, you know, the speech signal is very ambiguous.
ambiguous.zh: 所以，你知道，语音信号是非常含糊不清的。

ambiguous.en: In the Arab world, he is a more ambiguous symbol—to some, a hero who fought for Arab independence; to others, a man who, knowingly or not, played a role in one of the greatest betrayals of the modern Middle East.
ambiguous.zh: 在阿拉伯世界，他是一个更具争议的象征——对一些人来说，他是为阿拉伯独立而战的英雄；对另一些人来说，他是一个无论有意还是无意，都在现代中东最伟大的背叛之一中扮演了角色的人。

ambition.en: What he found was a movement that was full of ambition but lacking a defined strategy.
ambition.zh: 他发现这是一场充满雄心但缺乏明确战略的运动。

ambition.en: And all of them had opinions, ambitions, and networks of influence.
ambition.zh: 所有人都有自己的观点、野心和影响力网络。

ambition.en: He was a man of his time. A product of colonialism, Cold War politics, and personal ambition.
ambition.zh: 他是特定时代的产物。是殖民主义、冷战政治和个人野心的结晶。

ambition.en: And Wyatt Earp had ambitions to become county sheriff himself.
ambition.zh: 而 Wyatt Earp 自己则一心想当上县警长。

ambition.en: His wife had stood by him while he pursued his political ambitions, and the pair had two daughters together.
ambition.zh: 在他追求政治抱负的过程中，妻子一直支持他，两人育有两个女儿。

amid.en: But amid all of this chaos, there were two people who provided some stability: his grandparents, Mamaw and Papaw.
amid.zh: 但在所有这些混乱之中，有两个人为他提供了一些稳定性：他的祖父母，Mamaw 和 Papaw。

amid.en: Amid the mud, blood, and sheer senselessness of it all, Fawcett began to question the supposed superiority of Western progress.
amid.zh: 在一片泥泞、血腥和毫无意义的混乱之中，Fawcett 开始质疑西方进步所谓的优越性。

amuse.en: The camps continue. But what Otto's case did was to make something vivid and undeniable that had previously been easy, for many people, to file away as abstract: North Korea is not merely strange or amusing or ideologically peculiar.
amuse.zh: 那些劳改营也仍在继续运转。但奥托的案子所起到的作用，是让一件事变得鲜活而不容否认——而在此之前，许多人很容易把这件事当作一种抽象的概念束之高阁：朝鲜不只是奇怪、好笑，或者意识形态上有些古怪而已。

ambassador.en: Or as one US ambassador’s private notes put it, “this was an extremely intelligent man, very young, perhaps immature, but a man with great potential”.
ambassador.zh: 或者正如一位美国大使的私人笔记所写的那样，“这是一个极其聪明的人，非常年轻，或许还不成熟，但有着巨大的潜力”。

ambassador.en: Starmer was criticized for accepting gifts from wealthy donors, and his decision to appoint Peter Mandelson as Britain’s ambassador to the United States was really criticized because Mandelson was quite associated with the infamous Jeffrey Epstein.
ambassador.zh: Starmer因接受富裕捐赠者的礼物而受到批评，而他任命Peter Mandelson为英国驻美国大使的决定更是饱受诟病，因为Mandelson与臭名昭著的杰弗里·爱泼斯坦（Jeffrey Epstein）关系密切。
